articles.summary: ATLANTA , Sept. 10, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oxford Industries, Inc. (NYSE:OXM) today announced financial results for its second quarter of fiscal 2025 ended August 2, 2025 . Consolidated net sales in the second quarter of fiscal 2025 were $403 million compared to $420 million in the second quarter
articles.title: Oxford: Owner of Tommy Bahama, Lilly Pulitzer and Johnny Was Reports Second Quarter Results
